newsitem.title: USA: Marine Drilling sees improved oper result.
newsitem.headline: Marine Drilling sees improved oper result.

text.p: Marine Drilling Cos Inc said Thursday it expects continued improvement in operating results during the rest of 1997.

The company said the improvements will come from strong drilling market conditions, the deployment of its new drilling rig, the MARINE 305, in the third quarter, and contracted day rate improvements on several of its rigs.

The company said its marketed rigs were 100 percent utilized during the second quarter at an average day rate of about $35,500 compared with first-quarter performance of 100 percent and $32,800 respectively.
The company reported earnings per share for the quarter of $0.26 compared to $0.10 per share for the same period a year ago.
